contract: Sahabat Belajar (SLB B-C Wijayakusumah) Auth Visual Contract. Unified frosted glass design over bg.png, child-friendly wide interactive student login card with speech guide and live 6-slot PIN boxes, and consistent illustrated teacher login card with format & Caps Lock assistance.

accessibility.evidence: Verified with scripts/check-contrast.mjs passing WCAG AA/AAA. Student card adds explicit tap-only voice guidance (Dengar) and toggleable PIN visibility (Lihat) without autoplay or flashing animations; teacher card includes password toggle, email format check, and Caps Lock indicator.

responsive.evidence: Student horizontal card (.student-grid) aligns symmetrically on desktop (<= 780px wide, ~423px tall) and collapses cleanly to 1 column at <= 740px. Teacher card fits cleanly within 1366x768/1440x900 viewports and mobile screens.

loading.evidence: Teacher submit transitions calmly to 'Memeriksa...' state; student view updates slots without layout shifts.

empty.evidence: Empty states in content modules remain clear and polite.

error.evidence: Inline validation errors and warm amber alerts render clearly inside both cards.

partial.reason: Login screens render complete interactive panels synchronously.

success.evidence: Student and teacher authentication flows pass all 8 tests in AuthTest.

permission.evidence: Guest and role access boundaries tested cleanly across the suite.
